explanation: The English article of the war opens on the coup and gives it as what began the war: “The Myanmar civil war began following the military coup on 1 February 2021. The seizure of power triggered mass anti-coup demonstrations and a violent crackdown by the Tatmadaw (Myanmar armed forces), which significantly escalated the country’s longstanding insurgencies.” The insurgencies are older than the coup and the article says so; what it dates to February 2021 is the war.
